item.title: Has travel gotten too expensive? Yes, and here’s what to do about it
item.description: Does it cost too much to travel? For people like Tim Plyant, the answer is yes. This summer, he plans to avoid travel entirely -- it's just too expensive.

item.title: My Enterprise rental car broke down! Do I deserve a refund?
item.description: When John Sand landed in Munich and picked up his rental car from Enterprise, he was ready for a fun-filled European road trip. Instead, he took an unexpected detour that left him without wheels for 36 hours and forced him to navigate a Kafkaesque customer service maze.

item.title: I paid Holland America for a cruise, but now it wants another $800!
item.description: Greg Rothman thought his Holland America cruise was locked in: a seven-day Caribbean sailing in a veranda stateroom for $650, courtesy of an MGM casino certificate. He pays in full and then books non-refundable airline tickets from Los Angeles to Fort Lauderdale. Hours later, a second invoice arrives -- this one demanding another $800 or threatening to bump him down to a windowless interior cabin.

item.title: Beware the Vortex! How a $197 hair gadget sparked a three-month fight with American Express
item.description: Joanne Pantaleo thought her pricey high-frequency wand would grow hair, not headaches. After the gadget died, the merchant vanished, and American Express sided with the fraudsters. Is she stuck with a broken gadget?

item.title: This is the most dangerous thing you can do when you travel
item.description: It never crossed my mind that the most dangerous thing in Nairobi would be on the road. A mosquito carrying an exotic disease or a hippopotamus, maybe. But when I boarded a bus -- and then gripped the seat in front of me in panic as it nearly collided with several vehicles on the road -- I knew I was wrong.

item.title: Will an Iran war ground your travel plans?
item.description: If you’re holding a ticket to Europe or Asia, you might want to check your flight status after you finish this article. The U.S. military is massing an impressive amount of hardware in the Persian Gulf, with reports suggesting a decision to attack Iran could come within the next week.

item.title: Your airline might be spying on you — and it should be illegal
item.description: When Cary Tatkin searched for the lowest airfare to Europe, he didn’t realize Lufthansa might be running its own search for the highest price it could extract from him.

item.title: CONSUMER ALERT: Airlines are hiking bag fees—again
item.description: Don't look now, but the cost of checking your luggage is quietly rising again. American Airlines just raised the price for a second checked bag for tickets issued on or after February 20.

item.title: AI is making travel scams impossible to spot — unless you know these strategies
Chase made my $1,000 payment vanish into thin air — how do I get it back?
item.description: When Joanne Smikle made a $1,000 payment on her Chase credit card bill, she assumed the transaction had gone through. The money left her Tower Federal Credit Union account. Chase credited the payment. Everything looked normal.
